_metadata.dataset: Day 17 — Real Multimodal Evidence Extraction Cases
_metadata.description: Genuinely messy multimodal financial evidence for extraction evaluation. NOT part of the deterministic benchmark.

cases.raw_text: bhai maine kal 20k bhej diya usko

cases.description: Hinglish with named recipient and weekday
cases.raw_text: Rahul bhai ko 20 hazar UPI kiya tha Tuesday

cases.description: English with reference number and relative date

cases.raw_text: ₹25,000 sent to ABC yesterday but bank shows only 20k

expected.notes: The first explicit amount (25000) should be extracted. Conflicting amounts are a downstream contradiction detection concern.

cases.description: Vague payment claim with no amount — correct answer is UNKNOWN amount
cases.raw_text: maine usko payment kar diya tha, check once

expected.notes: Amount is genuinely unknown. Extractor must NOT fabricate an amount.
Mock provider should return a claim with uncertain values. Live VLM should extract visible text from the image.
Image evidence — actual values require VLM.
Invoice image — VLM should extract invoice number, amount, billed-to.
Scanned PDF — text extraction should fail, VLM extraction should be attempted.
Multi-page scanned PDF — should detect 2 pages and extract images.

cases.description: Conflicting evidence — two texts describing different amounts for same payment
raw_texts: Maine Ravi ko 15k UPI kiya tha Monday
Ravi says he received only 10k from me via UPI

expected.notes: Both should extract independently. Contradiction detection is downstream.

cases.description: Missing fields — payment with no amount, no date, no recipient

expected.notes: All fields genuinely unknown — extractor must preserve unknowns.

cases.raw_text: Paym3nt of Rs.12,5O0 recei ved from Suni1 on 2O/O8/2O26 via UPl ref 4O82l9381920

expected.notes: OCR noise with digit/letter substitutions. Extractor may struggle — that's acceptable. Should not hallucinate clean values.

cases.description: Multiple evidence items describing one payment
raw_texts: Sent 30k to Vikram via NEFT today ref NEFTN26235889012
NEFT transfer Rs 30,000 to Vikram completed. Reference: NEFTN26235889012

expected.notes: Both describe the same payment. Deduplication is downstream.

cases.description: Evidence where correct answer is UNKNOWN — non-financial chat
cases.raw_text: Good morning bhai! Kaise ho? Kal milte hain office mein.

expected.notes: Casual greeting — no financial claim should be extracted.
